newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's MEFF debt volume hits record in June.
newsitem.headline: Spain's MEFF debt volume hits record in June.

text.p: The trading volume of fixed income derivatives on Spain's MEFF futures exchange rose to a record of 3.02 million contracts in June, up 54 percent versus the year-earlier month, MEFF said on Wednesday.
The accumulated volume of trade during the first six months of the year was 14.95 million contracts, up 32 percent from the year-earlier period.
In the six months to end-June the average daily volume was 122,522 contracts, representing 2.3 trillion pesetas per day in nominal terms.
